answer: Consider Building permit history with municipal planning attestation as the gate. With permits issued over years and stamped by the municipal planning office in place, the pulse an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Time is the tax here: permits issued over years and stamped by the municipal planning office cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the lotus for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of. The basalt is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
